BlueOptions Gold 1505 ($0 Virtual Visits / $20 PCP Visits / $15 Generic Meds / Rewards $$$)

Carrier: Florida Blue (BlueCross BlueShield FL). Plan type: EPO. Period: 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31.

27 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 17 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document FLORIDA_BLUE_BLUEOPTIONS_GOLD_1505 (schema version 1.1.0).
